messages.content: I feel like I have to perform happiness for other people even when I'm not okay.
That's an exhausting thing to carry, performing a feeling you don't actually have. Who specifically do you feel that pressure with most?
Mostly my family, they get worried if I seem off so I just fake being fine.

That's a really understandable pattern, protecting them from worry, but it also means you're carrying things alone that don't need to be carried alone. Is there anyone at all you let see the real version, even a little?
